purpose: Post hoc, evaluation-only projection of existing reference samples into saved training-view prior, DA3, anchor, and final depth arrays. No training, rendering, inference, extraction, registration, or masking.
reference_selection: Nearest existing evaluation sample to the stated target within fixed half-open bounds; no new reference processing.
camera_selection: All training cameras in front of reference point and >=10 pixels from image boundary, sorted by descending downward ray vertical cosine, then image name. Report first 3; no outcome-based selection.
depth_sample: Nearest integer array pixel via numpy rint; also report same 5x5 array-pixel patch finite-positive min, median, max. Prior uses Open3D rays at u+0.5,v+0.5 whereas saved GS uses integer u,v. DA3 original-grid resizing has its own interpolation convention. Therefore equal array indices are not exactly equal rays; no resampling was applied. Projected point camera-Z is an evaluation-only target, not a raycast or visibility proof.
